FFmpeg for Windows is downloaded by scripts/download-ffmpeg.mjs from the
BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds GitHub release named "ffmpeg-master-latest-win64-lgpl-shared.zip".

The selected build is LGPL. Its distributed archive includes its license and
notices alongside the executables. The unmodified archive is the source of the
FFmpeg binaries bundled in the Windows application.

Source: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
FFmpeg project and license text: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
